title: Identity vs Image Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 21
description:
Laddoo Lab thinks it is healthy, honest and home-made. But when Zoya asked parents, one word kept coming up: expensive. In this animated lesson we use Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from a Bengaluru home kitchen, to understand the difference between brand identity and brand image.

You will see identity as the message a company sends and image as the message customers receive, with Kevin Lane Keller's description of brand image as associations held in memory. Then we run Zoya's school-gate survey live: thirty parents give three words each, the words are counted against the identity she wanted, the gaps show up (honest is rarely said, expensive is said a lot), and two honest fixes close them. We walk through Jean-Noel Kapferer's brand identity prism for Laddoo Lab, and identity and image at work today in a bank, a food delivery app, an airline and a hospital. The human side: listening shows what to fix, but an image changes slowly, and a strong image needs associations that are strong, favourable and unique (Keller, 1993).

This is Episode 21 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
